scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Roll, Auto Farm, Auto Tower & Auto Rebirth
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Anime Dice combines fast Auto Roll, AFK money farming, Auto Tower, Auto Rebirth, and targeted trait and grade rerolls. Automatically manage your plot, collect unit income, upgrade your team, and filter unwanted units from one customizable menu.

AUTO ROLL & AFK FARM

- Total AFK Mode — enable rolling, selling, income collection, and best-unit placement together.
- Fast Auto Roll — customize the delay between roll attempts.
- Stop On Target — stop rolling at your chosen rarity, mutation, or roll count.
- Rare Drop Alerts — receive notifications for your selected rarity and above.
- Auto Collect Money — collect income from your plot with an adjustable interval.
- Auto Use Spins — consume available spin items.
- Auto Use Boosts — select Luck, Income, Damage, Multiplier, or all boost types.

UNITS & INVENTORY

- Auto Equip Best — automatically place your best units on your plot.
- Auto Tower Team — equip your best available tower team.
- Auto Hold Best Unit — hold your highest-income unit.
- Auto Level Up — upgrade plotted units with a target level and money reserve.
- Auto Lock Units — lock units matching your keep filters.
- Auto Sell — sell unwanted units automatically or at a chosen inventory threshold.
- Detailed Keep Filters — preserve selected rarities, mutations, traits, grades, and levels.
- Locked and plotted units are excluded from Auto Sell.

AUTO TRAIT & GRADE REROLLS

- Auto Grade Reroll — use available Gems until your selected grade or better appears.
- Auto Trait Reroll — use available reroll items until a selected trait appears.
- Choose individual units and track their reroll history.
- View live grade, trait, mutation, level, and income information.

AUTO TOWER & PROGRESSION

- Auto Tower — run your selected tower with optional automatic restarts.
- Equip your best tower team before each run.
- View estimated difficulty relative to your team.
- Track floors, runs, enemy health, and team status.
- Auto Rebirth — rebirth when the required money conditions are met.
- Auto Buy Dice — purchase the next dice or the best affordable option.
- Auto Buy Upgrades — prioritize Luck, Money, Damage, Health, or mixed upgrades.

TRADING TOOLS

- Automatically send trade requests to a selected player or User ID.
- Filter incoming requests using whitelists, blacklists, and account age.
- Choose offered units, exclusion filters, and maximum units per trade.
- Optional Auto Ready and Confirm.
- Locked and plotted units are excluded from outgoing offers.

REWARDS & EXTRAS

- Auto claim eligible daily rewards, offline earnings, group rewards, and completed quests.
- Auto redeem codes from the game’s code list.
- Spend available quest tickets on selected Gems, Trait Rerolls, or Lucky Spins.
- Adjustable WalkSpeed, JumpPower, and Fly speed.
- Infinite Jump, Noclip, and teleport to your plot on respawn.
- Anti-AFK, Auto Rejoin, and saved configurations.

local function safeParent()
	local ok, hidden = pcall(function()
		return (gethui and gethui()) or (get_hidden_gui and get_hidden_gui())
	end)
	if ok and typeof(hidden) == "Instance" then return hidden end
	if pcall(function() return CoreGui.Name end) then return CoreGui end
	return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local Parent = safeParent()

for _, v in ipairs(Parent:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == GUI_NAME then pcall(function() v:Destroy() end) end
end
pcall(function()
	local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if pg and pg:FindFirstChild(WM_NAME) then pg[WM_NAME]:Destroy() end
end)
pcall(function()
	local old = SoundService:FindFirstChild("MachoBell")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
end)

	Power = 97000,

	Keybind = Enum.KeyCode.V,
	Binding = false,
	Hidden = false,
	Minimized = false,
}

local lagConn = nil
local lagAmount = 0.15

local function applyPower(val)
	State.Power = math.clamp(math.floor(val), 10000, 500000)
	local t = (State.Power - 10000) / 490000
	lagAmount = t * 0.2
end
applyPower(State.Power)

local function startLag()
	if lagConn then lagConn:Disconnect() end
	lagConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not State.Active then return end
		if lagAmount > 0 then
			local t = tick()
			while tick() - t < lagAmount do end
		end
	end)
end

local function stopLag()
	if lagConn then
		lagConn:Disconnect()
		lagConn = nil
	end
end

	end

local function updateBypassLayout()
	if State.Mode == "MOBILE" then
		KeyBtn.Visible = false

	end

local function setMode(mode)
	State.Mode = mode
	if mode == "PC" then
		PCBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C_NEON
		PCBtn.TextColor3 = C_BG
		MobileBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C_ROW
		MobileBtn.TextColor3 = C_DIM
		applyPower(97000)
		PowerBox.Text = tostring(State.Power)
	else
		MobileBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C_NEON
		MobileBtn.TextColor3 = C_BG
		PCBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C_ROW
		PCBtn.TextColor3 = C_DIM
		applyPower(72000)
		PowerBox.Text = tostring(State.Power)
	end
	refreshFooter()
	updateBypassLayout()
	if State.Active then
		stopLag()
		startLag()
	end
end

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setActive(not State.Active)
end)

PowerBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local n = tonumber(PowerBox.Text)
	if n and n > 0 then
		applyPower(n)
	end
	PowerBox.Text = tostring(State.Power)
	refreshFooter()
	if State.Active then
		stopLag()
		startLag()
	end
end)

end)

local TW = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function setMinimized(on)
	State.Minimized = on
	if on then
		Mini.Position = Main.Position
		local t = TweenService:Create(MainScale, TW, {Scale = 0.92})
		t:Play()
		t.Completed:Wait()
		Main.Visible = false
		MainScale.Scale = 1
		MiniScale.Scale = 0.92
		MiniTint.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
		Mini.Visible = true
		TweenService:Create(MiniScale, TW, {Scale = 1}):Play()
	else
		Main.Position = Mini.Position
		local t = TweenService:Create(MiniScale, TW, {Scale = 0.92})
		t:Play()
		t.Completed:Wait()
		Mini.Visible = false
		MiniScale.Scale = 1
		MainScale.Scale = 0.92
		Main.Visible = true
		TweenService:Create(MainScale, TW, {Scale = 1}):Play()
	end
end

local dragTarget, dragStart, dragOrigin = nil, nil, nil

local function hookDrag(frame, moveTarget)
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragTarget = moveTarget
			dragStart = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			dragOrigin = moveTarget.Position
		end
	end)
end

hookDrag(Main, Main)
hookDrag(MiniTint, Mini)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragTarget then return end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
	and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end

	local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - dragStart
	dragTarget.Position = UDim2.new(
		dragOrigin.X.Scale, math.floor(dragOrigin.X.Offset + delta.X),
		dragOrigin.Y.Scale, math.floor(dragOrigin.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	)
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragTarget = nil
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end

	if State.Binding then
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
		State.Binding = false
		if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			State.Keybind = input.KeyCode
		end
		KeyBtn.Text = State.Keybind.Name
		return
	end

	if gpe then return end

	if input.KeyCode == State.Keybind then
		setActive(not State.Active)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
		State.Hidden = not State.Hidden
		ScreenGui.Enabled = not State.Hidden
	end
end)

-- Function to apply a glowing highlight to a model
local function applyHighlight(model, fillFolder, color)
    if not model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight") then
        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.FillColor = color
        highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.Adornee = model
        highlight.Parent = fillFolder
        return highlight
    end
end

-- Clear highlights helper
local function clearEspGroup(groupTable)
    for model, hl in pairs(groupTable) do
        if hl then hl:Destroy() end
        groupTable[model] = nil
    end
end

-- Loop to continuously scan and update ESP visual positions

    -- 1. Manage Player ESP
    if playerEspEnabled then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                if not playerHighlights[p.Character] then
                    -- Cyan glow for friendly players
                    playerHighlights[p.Character] = applyHighlight(p.Character, ScreenGui, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255))
                end
            end
        end
    else
        clearEspGroup(playerHighlights)
    end

    -- 2. Manage Cat in the Hat Monster ESP
    if catEspEnabled then
        -- Scans workspace for anything matching the monster character setup
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            -- Checks for models containing 'Cat' or typical monster tags in Scream & Run
            if obj:IsA("Model") and (string.find(string.lower(obj.Name), "cat") or obj:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")) and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then

                        catHighlights[obj] = applyHighlight(obj, ScreenGui, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        clearEspGroup(catHighlights)
    end
end)

        task.wait(1)
        
        local fadeOut = TweenService:Create(keyFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        local boxFade = TweenService:Create(keyBox, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        local strokeFade = TweenService:Create(keyBoxStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {Transparency = 1})
        local labelFade = TweenService:Create(keyLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {TextTransparency = 1})
        local inputFade = TweenService:Create(keyInput, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1})
        local inputStrokeFade = TweenService:Create(keyInputStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {Transparency = 1})
        local statusFade = TweenService:Create(statusLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {TextTransparency = 1})
        
        fadeOut:Play()
        boxFade:Play()
        strokeFade:Play()
        labelFade:Play()
        inputFade:Play()
        inputStrokeFade:Play()
        statusFade:Play()
        
        fadeOut.Completed:Wait()
        keyFrame:Destroy()
        
        sendChatMessage("[OBI SPAMMER LOADED 👑]")
        
        local introFrame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
        introFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        introFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 0, 0)
        introFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        introFrame.ZIndex = 100
        
        local introText = Instance.new("TextLabel", introFrame)
        introText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        introText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        introText.Text = "๏вī   I S   H E R E  🗿👑"
        introText.Font = Enum.Font.Creepster
        introText.TextSize = 45
        introText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 0)
        introText.TextTransparency = 1
        introText.ZIndex = 101
        
        sendChatMessage("[OBI INTRO STARTS]")
        
        local tweenIn = TweenService:Create(introText, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = 0})
        tweenIn:Play()
        tweenIn.Completed:Wait()
        
        task.wait(1.5)
        
        TweenService:Create(introText, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        local bgOut = TweenService:Create(introFrame, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        bgOut:Play()
        bgOut.Completed:Wait()
        
        sendChatMessage("[OBI INTRO END]")
        
        introFrame:Destroy()
        
        toggleBtn.Visible = true
        mainFrame.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 290)}):Play()
        
    else
        statusLabel.Text = "INVALID"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        
        local originalPos = keyBox.Position
        for i = 1, 3 do
            TweenService:Create(keyBox, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Position = originalPos + UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)}):Play()
            task.wait(0.05)
            TweenService:Create(keyBox, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Position = originalPos - UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)}):Play()
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        TweenService:Create(keyBox, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Position = originalPos}):Play()
        
        task.wait(1)
        statusLabel.Text = ""
        keyInput.Text = ""
    end
end)

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local lp = players.LocalPlayer
local function infect(player)
if player == lp then return end
local hitbox = lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
if hitbox then
if hitbox:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter") then
firetouchinterest(hitbox, player.Character.Hitbox, 0)
task.wait()
firetouchinterest(hitbox, player.Character.Hitbox, 1)
end
end
end

for i, v in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
task.wait()
infect(v)
end

lp.Character.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(an)
if an == "IsZombie" and lp.Character:GetAttribute("IsZombie") == true then
for i, v in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
task.wait()
infect(v)
end
end
end)
